--- if simple
on t(x)
    if x then
        return 1
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- if else
on t(x)
    if x > 0 then
        set r to "pos"
    else
        set r to "neg"
    end if
    return r
end t
--- if else if chain
on t(x)
    if x = 1 then
        set r to "one"
    else if x = 2 then
        set r to "two"
    else if x = 3 then
        set r to "three"
    else
        set r to "many"
    end if
    return r
end t
--- if else if without else
on t(x)
    set r to ""
    if x = 1 then
        set r to "one"
    else if x = 2 then
        set r to "two"
    end if
    return r
end t
--- if nested
on t(x, y)
    if x then
        if y then
            return 1
        else
            return 2
        end if
    else
        if y then
            return 3
        end if
    end if
    return 4
end t
--- if else containing if and more
on t(x, y)
    if x then
        set r to 1
    else
        if y then
            set r to 2
        end if
        set r to r + 1
    end if
    return r
end t
--- if empty branches
on t(x)
    if x then
    end if
    if x then
    else
        return 1
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- if one line
on t(x)
    if x then return 1
    if not x then set y to 2
    return y
end t
--- if with returns in both
on t(x)
    if x then
        return "a"
    else
        return "b"
    end if
end t
--- if as last statement value
on t(x)
    if x then
        "a"
    else
        "b"
    end if
end t
--- repeat forever exit
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat
        set n to n + 1
        if n > x then exit repeat
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat times
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat 3 times
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    repeat x times
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    repeat (x + 1) times
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat while until
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat while n < x
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    repeat until n = 0
        set n to n - 1
    end repeat
    repeat while n < x and n ≠ 5
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat with range
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with i from 1 to x
        set n to n + i
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 1 to x by 2
        set n to n + i
    end repeat
    repeat with i from x to 1 by -1
        set n to n + i
    end repeat
    repeat with i from (x - 1) to (x + 1)
        set n to n + i
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 0 to (count of {1, 2}) by x
        set n to n + i
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat with in
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with e in x
        set n to n + e
    end repeat
    repeat with e in {1, 2, 3}
        set n to n + (contents of e)
    end repeat
    repeat with e in items 2 thru -1 of x
        set n to n + e
    end repeat
    repeat with c in characters of "abc"
        set n to n + 1
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat nested with exit
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with i from 1 to x
        repeat with j from 1 to i
            if j > 3 then exit repeat
            set n to n + 1
        end repeat
        if n > 100 then exit repeat
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- repeat with return inside
on t(x)
    repeat with e in x
        if e > 1 then return e
    end repeat
    return missing value
end t
--- repeat empty bodies
on t(x)
    repeat 2 times
    end repeat
    repeat with i from 1 to x
    end repeat
    repeat with e in x
    end repeat
    repeat while false
    end repeat
end t
--- repeat with if else inside
on t(x)
    set a to 0
    set b to 0
    repeat with e in x
        if e mod 2 = 0 then
            set a to a + 1
        else
            set b to b + 1
        end if
    end repeat
    return {a, b}
end t
--- repeat until with exit and continue trick
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with i from 1 to x
        repeat 1 times
            if i = 2 then exit repeat
            set n to n + i
        end repeat
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- try simple
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try on error
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    on error
        set r to 0
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try on error message number
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    on error msg number n
        set r to {msg, n}
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try on error all
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    on error msg number n from f to c partial result p
        set r to {msg, n, f, c, p}
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try on error number only
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    on error number n
        set r to n
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try nested
on t(x)
    try
        try
            set r to x + 1
        on error
            set r to x & 1
        end try
    on error msg
        set r to msg
    end try
    return r
end t
--- try in repeat with exit
on t(x)
    set n to 0
    repeat with e in x
        try
            set n to n + e
        on error
            exit repeat
        end try
    end repeat
    return n
end t
--- try with return
on t(x)
    try
        return x + 1
    on error
        return 0
    end try
end t
--- try in if in try
on t(x)
    try
        if x then
            try
                return 1
            end try
        else
            return 2
        end if
    on error e
        return e
    end try
    return 3
end t
--- try empty error body
on t(x)
    try
        set r to x + 1
    on error
    end try
    try
    end try
    return 1
end t
--- error forms
on t(x)
    if x = 1 then error "plain"
    if x = 2 then error "with number" number 42
    if x = 3 then error number -128
    if x = 4 then error "full" number 1 from x to integer partial result {x}
    if x = 5 then error
    if x = 6 then error x
    if x = 7 then error "a" & x number x + 1
    return 0
end t
--- error rethrow
on t(x)
    try
        return x + 1
    on error msg number n from f to c partial result p
        error msg number n from f to c partial result p
    end try
end t
--- error rethrow partial
on t(x)
    try
        return x + 1
    on error msg number n
        if n = -128 then
            error number -128
        else
            error "wrapped: " & msg number n
        end if
    end try
end t
--- considering forms
on t(x, y)
    considering case
        set a to x = y
    end considering
    ignoring case
        set b to x = y
    end ignoring
    considering case, diacriticals and punctuation
        set c to x = y
    end considering
    ignoring white space and hyphens
        set d to x = y
    end ignoring
    considering numeric strings
        set e to x < y
    end considering
    considering case but ignoring white space
        set f to x = y
    end considering
    ignoring case but considering diacriticals
        set g to x = y
    end ignoring
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g}
end t
--- considering nested and return
on t(x, y)
    considering case
        ignoring white space
            if x = y then return true
        end ignoring
    end considering
    return false
end t
--- ignoring application responses
on t()
    ignoring application responses
        tell application "Finder" to activate
    end ignoring
end t
--- timeout
on t(x)
    with timeout of 30 seconds
        set r to x + 1
    end timeout
    with timeout of x seconds
        set r to r + 1
    end timeout
    with timeout of (x * 60) seconds
        set r to r + 1
    end timeout
    return r
end t
--- transaction
on t(x)
    tell application "Finder"
        with transaction
            set r to name of startup disk
        end transaction
    end tell
    return r
end t
--- return forms
on t(x)
    if x = 1 then return
    if x = 2 then return 2
    if x = 3 then return {x, x}
    if x = 4 then return x + 1
    return missing value
end t
--- return in the middle
on t(x)
    set a to 1
    return a
    set a to 2
end t
--- no return value of last statement
on t(x)
    set a to x + 1
    a * 2
end t
--- implicit run with statements
set a to 1
set b to a + 1
if b > 1 then
    set b to 0
end if
return b
--- explicit run with argv
on run argv
    if (count of argv) > 0 then return item 1 of argv
    return ""
end run
--- run and other handlers
on helper(x)
    return x + 1
end helper

on run
    return helper(1)
end run
--- top level statements and handler
on helper(x)
    return x + 1
end helper

set r to helper(1)
return r
--- exit repeat in if else in repeat in try
on t(x)
    try
        repeat with e in x
            if e = 1 then
                exit repeat
            else if e = 2 then
                error "two"
            else
                set r to e
            end if
        end repeat
    on error
        return 0
    end try
    return r
end t
--- while with complex condition and nested if
on t(x, y)
    repeat while (x > 0 and y > 0) or x = -1
        if x > y then
            set x to x - y
        else
            set y to y - x
        end if
    end repeat
    return x + y
end t
--- repeat with list of records
on t(x)
    set names to {}
    repeat with r in x
        set end of names to name of r
        set {a, b} to {id of r, class of r}
    end repeat
    return names
end t
--- deep nesting
on t(x)
    if x > 0 then
        repeat with i from 1 to x
            try
                tell me
                    considering case
                        with timeout of 5 seconds
                            if i = 2 then
                                return i
                            end if
                        end timeout
                    end considering
                end tell
            on error
                exit repeat
            end try
        end repeat
    end if
    return 0
end t
--- copy as the last statement of a block
on t(x, y)
    if x then
        copy x to y
    else
        copy {1, 2} to y
    end if
    tell x
        copy x to y
    end tell
    try
        copy x to y
    on error
        copy y to x
    end try
    considering case
        copy x to y
    end considering
    with timeout of 5 seconds
        copy x to y
    end timeout
    repeat 2 times
        copy x to y
    end repeat
    copy x to y
end t
--- pattern as the last statement of a block
on f(x)
    return {x, x}
end f
on t(x)
    if x then
        set {a, b} to f(x)
    else
        copy f(x) to {a, b}
    end if
    try
        set {a, b} to f(x)
    on error
        set {b, a} to f(x)
    end try
    tell x
        set {a, b} to f(x)
    end tell
    set {a, b} to f(x)
end t
on u(x)
    copy f(x) to {a, b}
end u
--- script object as the last statement of a try block
on t(x)
    try
        script s
            on g()
                return 1
            end g
        end script
    on error
        script u
        end script
    end try
end t
--- empty line that ends a block
on t(x)
    if x then
        log 1

    end if
    try
        log 1

    on error
        log 2

    end try
    repeat 2 times
        log 1

    end repeat

end t

on u()
    log 1

end u
